blocks.text: LVIV, Ukraine — Britain’s Prince Harry made a surprise visit to Ukraine over the weekend, meeting wounded veterans and medics specializing in war injuries and telling them: “You’re going to win the war.” Making his fourth visit to Ukraine since Russia’s 2022 invasion, Prince Harry told wounded soldiers that “the world will continue to support” Kyiv and expressed hope that the lengthy war would end. He took part in events Saturday and Sunday in the western city of Lviv, with the trip kept secret for security reasons.
